headline: US-Canada Energy Trade Remains Excluded From Tariff Disputes
summary: Despite elevated tariff rhetoric and trade disputes between US President Donald Trump and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney, cross-border oil and gas flows have remained entirely untouched by punitive tariffs.
why: The US relies heavily on Canadian heavy crude imports for Midwest and Gulf Coast refineries, making North American energy flows economically interdependent.

impacts.name: Canadian Energy
impacts.why: Tariff exemptions preserve uninterrupted cross-border crude export revenues for Canadian producers.
